app.notes: From hosts' feedback. The first step shows each model's share of the network's work, as the network measured it, instead of a count of hosts. When you choose a host for the other models, you see each host's record: epochs on the network, epochs running that model, missed requests and GPUs, and GNOT's own pick prefers hosts with a steady record. While the Monitor is open, it checks the hosts your nodes chose and warns you, with one desktop notice per epoch, if one has left or stopped answering; nothing changes until you choose another. The wallet reads the gas price from the network. Electron 44.11.5.
